title: Three commands, each a finite batch job
description: Only refresh touches the network. Build and render are pure functions of files.

nodes.title: cargo network refresh
nodes.detail: Reads sources.toml and the publisher sites. Writes state/.

nodes.title: cargo network build
nodes.detail: Reads state/, curation.toml and pages/. Writes Zola content, view data and network-data/.

nodes.title: zola build
nodes.detail: Renders public/: static files for any host.
